title: Battle of Plassey
hook: Plassey ki ladai ne India ka itihas kaise badla?

facts.Between: Robert Clive (East India Company) vs Siraj-ud-Daulah
facts.Result: Company ka Bengal par control shuru

exam_points: Plassey (1757) ko Company rule ki neev mana jata hai.
Iske baad 1764 ka Buxar yuddh Company ki pakad aur mazboot karta hai.

mcqs.q: Plassey ke yuddh mein Nawab kaun tha?
